snippet.title: The Spotter: Dig or Die. Out NOW! ⛏️ NEVER. STOP. DIGGING.
snippet.description:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3976500/The_Spotter_Dig_or_Die/

The Spotter: Dig or Die is a hole-digging job sim meets tower defense, where you turn a ruined gas station into humanity’s new hope. Scavenge the wasteland, fight mutants, build turrets and traps, discover roguelike artifacts, and most importantly: NEVER. STOP. DIGGING.
